summary: Iteration-6 full-stack test of Translation Label feature. Backend: PUT /api/appearance/bible accepts translation_show (bool) and translation_position (Position literal); invalid position -> 422, non-bool show -> 422; defaults translation_show=true, translation_position='bottom-right' confirmed via GET /appearance/bible defaults. Frontend verse slide: bible-reference renders ABOVE bible-verse-text in the same centered FitText group (1920x1080: ref.y=290 < verse.y=387; 1080x1920: 565 < 663). Only ONE bible-reference element in DOM (no leftover footer line). Long verse Esther 8:9 at 1080x1920 fits entirely in viewport with reference visible (ref 486-551, verse 584-1361, viewport 1920). bible-translation-badge rendered via SlideMeta inside bible-meta-top or bible-meta-bottom row per translation_position, with data-position attr matching. Default renders in bottom-right row. Multi-verse Psalm 23:1-3 shows bible-slide-counter '1 / 3' in bottom-right while badge sits in configured corner. Live PUT updates propagate via WS to open /bible tab (top-left update observed). translation_show=false hides the badge entirely while counter remains. Settings-admin: PIN gate accepts 1234; Bible tab exposes translation-label-panel with translation-show-switch and 6 translation-pos-* buttons + appearance-save-btn; Register tab correctly has 0 translation-label-panel. Clicking translation-pos-top-center marks dirty 'Unsaved changes (preview only)' and preview iframe DisplayPreview updates immediately (bible-translation-badge data-position='top-center'). Regression: /bible idle Welcome + date renders correctly (church_name empty in user's current state); passage mode still shows church-name-top/bottom rows (shared ChurchName component unchanged). All user state restored exactly after tests (bible+register appearance snapshots PUT back, bible display cleared to idle).
critical_code_review_comments: appearance.py — translation_show/translation_position use the same Position Literal as church_name_position; shared across both displays. The Register appearance also exposes these keys since AppearanceIn is shared; the UI correctly hides TranslationLabelPanel on the Register tab (AppearanceEditor.jsx line 83 `display === 'bible'`). Keeping fields on the model but hiding in UI is acceptable and keeps the schema simple.

SlideMeta.jsx — clean, position-driven slot assignment; counter is pinned bottom-right by appending to slots.right after the badge is placed per translation_position; both can coexist in the same bottom row.

FitText (BibleDisplay.jsx) — reference + verse are now a single flex-column group measured as `group.scrollHeight > box.clientHeight`, so shrinking accounts for the reference height; verified with Esther 8:9 on portrait.

Settings live update works via WS; preview iframe DisplayPreview reflects unsaved form changes without saving (DisplayPreview must receive form via appearance prop — confirmed by badge data-position swap in iframe before Save).
Minor nit: translation_position shares the Position type with church_name_position — could use a dedicated alias for clarity, but not a bug.

Pre-existing (unrelated to iter6): 8 older backend tests still fail (test_iter4, test_church_name, test_appearance_pin, test_sanctuary). Root causes are stale expectations (expecting 'Grace Chapel' when user set 'Providence…' / now empty, logo expected absent but endpoint behavior changed, PIN-attempts race between parallel workers, 'normalized_reference' key moved in lookup response). These are regression test maintenance issues, not product bugs. Recommend main agent clean them up or mark seed-dependent.

success_rate.backend: 100% (5/5 iter6 tests; 86/94 overall — 8 pre-existing unrelated failures)

rca of the issue: Not a bug fix — net-new feature. Implementation is correct: appearance.py adds translation_show/translation_position fields with proper validation; SlideMeta.jsx renders the badge in the correct top/bottom row with left/center/right slot per data-position; FitText now wraps reference + verse in a single centered flex column (reference above). The old footer bible-ref line has been removed. Settings panel is scoped to display==='bible'. Live WS push correctly refreshes both the live display and the preview iframe.
